world_fit_review.pattern_specific_checks: Anthropomorphic cast pass: large rounded grey head, short torso, two relaxed hoof-like arms and two standing broad feet. Exactly two rhino horns lie sequentially along the snout, large front and smaller rear, rather than paired sideways forehead horns. Narrow pointed upper lip, leaf ears and one short tail retain black-rhino cues without white-rhino square lip or elephant trunk. Cream oval eyes, smile and warm watercolor contour match cast references. Native light/dark views show intact horn tips, no extra parts, no four-legged pose or backdrop.
world_fit_review.basis: Actual selected native source and light/dark composites assessed after the user specified two patterns; prior natural-pose technical QA is not reused as current adoption permission.

resolution_review.review_basis: Native light/dark composites visually inspected; species/face/contour remain readable. This is a static asset display limit, not a completed-video acceptance.

alpha_policy: Original RGBA bytes retained, alpha254 and imperceptible <8 isolated fringes are not erased; visible light/dark composites govern image-quality decision.
scope: One independent neutral original inspected at native resolution and on light/dark backgrounds. No poses, interpolation, runtime or completed-video acceptance claimed.
